units.source_text: 将此盛开的花比作我儿，毕竟是渺茫的啊！”

en.t: To compare this flower in full bloom to my child is, after all, a fleeting and hopeless thing!"

units.source_text: 信送到时，正好没人看见，王命妇便交给藤壶妃子看，并劝道：“给他个回信吧，就在这花瓣上写几个字也好。”

en.t: When the letter arrived, no one happened to see it, so Lady Omyobu handed it to Lady Fujitsubo to read and urged her, "Send him a reply; even a few words written on these petals would do."

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子心中也正在悲伤，便拿起笔来题两句诗：

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo was grieving in her heart as well, so she picked up the brush and wrote two lines of verse:
